can_do_statement: Can use an increasing range of adverbs in front position.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: However / Furthermore / Moreover / Actually — slot a wider set of adverbials at the clause head
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker opens the clause with a wider set of framing adverbials

positives: However I can study only on Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday.
Furthermore, the cost is much lower this year.
negatives: I went to the cinema yesterday.

can_do_statement: Can use place adverbs in the usual end position.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: verb + here/there/nearby/abroad/away/upstairs/downstairs — anchor the place at the clause tail
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker locates entities at the end of the clause

negatives: I went to the cinema yesterday.

can_do_statement: Can use degree adverbs in end position.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: verb + a lot / so much / very much — push the degree to the clause tail
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker amplifies degree at the end of the clause

positives: I am looking forward to seeing you so much!
negatives: I went to the cinema yesterday.

can_do_statement: Can use evaluative, viewpoint and sequencing adverbs outside the clause, in front position, as a cohesive device to link to a previous statement.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: Actually / However / Fortunately / Interestingly / In addition — fronted adverbs as cohesion hooks
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker head-loads a discourse link into the next clause

positives: Actually I want you to decide what colour my room should be.
Fortunately, the train was on time that morning.
negatives: I went to the cinema yesterday.

can_do_statement: Can use adverbs in mid position, to distance the writer from what they are saying.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: allegedly / supposedly / reportedly / theoretically / arguably / presumably — slot distancing adverbs medially
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker maximum-distance from the proposition mid-clause

positives: Piggy himself theoretically has all the necessary character traits.
The witness reportedly saw the suspect run toward the station.
negatives: I went to the cinema yesterday.

can_do_statement: Can use 'never' in front position followed by an inverted subject (most commonly 'I') + main verb, to give focus.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: Never + aux + I/you/we/they + verb — flip the clause around 'never' for dramatic focus
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker front-loads 'never' and rearranges the clause for emphasis

positives: Never have I seen such a realistic and impressive film before.
Never had I thought that would happen.
negatives: I never have seen such a realistic film.

can_do_statement: Can use 'hardly' in front position followed by an inverted subject and verb, to give focus.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: Hardly + aux + subject + verb — flip the clause around 'hardly' for dramatic foregrounding
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker front-loads 'hardly' and rearranges the clause for emphasis

positives: Hardly had he reached his front door when he heard the phone ringing.
Hardly had she finished her complaints when the bell rang.
